svg.text: Rear plate datum: Blender 13 vs Blender 14
Exact vertical sections through each port axis of the saved meshes, frame 1. Revision 14 moves only the I/O board 0.508 mm forward, so the plate inner face lies on the original Eagle strip datum.
Case front is left, outside is right. Nominal illustration geometry; not a physical-fit qualification.
